Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains how "Knowledge Base" collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
Privacy.section1Text: We collect your name and email address when you sign in via Google or GitHub. We also store your created notes and uploaded files.
Privacy.section2Title: 2. How do we use your data?
Privacy.section2Text: Your data is used only to allow you to use the application. We do not use your data for advertising.
Privacy.section3Text: We use Google Gemini AI to process your notes (e.g., summarization). Your content is not used for training AI models.
Privacy.section4Text: You can delete your account and all related data at any time independently through your profile page. You can also contact us via email if you have any additional questions.
